True def transform(grid):
    """Recolor every solid, full-height or full-width line to marker 2."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(row) == w and row and all(x == row[0] for x in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h))]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in rows:
        out[i] = [2] * w
    for j in cols:
        for i in range(h):
            out[i][j] = 2
    return out
